study_identification_part.si_4_title: A generalizable normative deep autoencoder for brain morphological anomaly detection: application to the multi-site StratiBip dataset on bipolar disorder in an external validation framework

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: HCP-YA used as normative training dataset; StratiBip used as multi-site external test dataset (HC and BD).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The normative model framework was trained on the confounders-free brain features extracted from the human connectome project young adults (HCP-YA) dataset ... and applied to multi-site data from the StratiBip network"; "The external test set consisted of data collected as part of the StratiBip network"
